summary: The residual normal form gives the stated diffuse nonloop subfamily and constants, restriction is monotone for both packing and slice scores, the accepted all-occurrence-plus-replacement ledger yields the simultaneous measure and barycenters, and the occurrence-load inequality plus affine barycenter identity proves the source-envelope lower bound. All strict inequalities, factors of four, nonempty denominators, and restriction-to-a-maximum-tag-family conditions are accounted for.
